how_this_file_is_enforced.agent_or_human: Each item in evals is a prompt and a list of assertions for an agent or a person. CI does not send these prompts to a model and does not score the assertions.
how_this_file_is_enforced.ci: The GitHub Actions job gate runs python3 scripts/test_gate.py and python3 scripts/run_evidence.py --skip-live. Those commands check the fixture files and the offline settle path. A green check is that mechanical run. It is not a pass of the prompts below.
how_this_file_is_enforced.effect_spotcheck: evals/results/spotcheck.md records that the live template notes were withdrawn and still reads the fixture refusals. CI does not score it. A green gate check is not a pass of that file.

evals.name: youtube-with-captions-or-asr
evals.ci_relationship: Not executed by CI. scripts/run_evidence.py does check the fixture files named in files. That fixture check is not this prompt.
evals.prompt: Please fully read this YouTube video and write a beginner-friendly method note once you actually have the spoken content: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KwhgfwOSToQ — if you cannot get a usable transcript, say you did not finish instead of summarizing from the title.
evals.expected_output: Either a knowledge note grounded in transcript/captions, with the sections 问题与做法, 完整怎么做, 翻车或别用, and 今天立刻动手一步, each quoting the transcript, or an explicit not-finished statement. Must not claim completion from title/description alone. A pasted path without a quote is not finished. A quote without analysis is not finished.
assertions: Does not treat title or description as sufficient evidence of having watched the video
Either analyzes a transcript/captions artifact and quotes it, or clearly states not finished
A note that only pastes a transcript path, without quoting the transcript, is not finished
A note that quotes the transcript and does not analyze it into reusable knowledge is not finished
Does not invent detailed spoken claims without text backing
Does not treat a passing citation check as proof that the captions match the audio

evals.name: no-transcript-must-refuse-final-deposit
evals.ci_relationship: Not executed by CI. scripts/run_evidence.py does check the fixture files named in files. That fixture check is not this prompt.
evals.prompt: A short video ASR just failed and returned empty text. The surrounding post has a punchy title. Should we mark this as fully processed knowledge and write the final vault note now? What exact status and next step do you recommend?
evals.expected_output: Refuse final knowledge deposit; require recoverable video job / retry; status stays pending or to_decide with needs-transcript semantics.
assertions: Refuses final knowledge deposit without transcript
Recommends enqueue or retry rather than warning-only completion
Does not use video duration as an exemption

evals.name: chinese-asr-hallucination-gate
evals.ci_relationship: Not executed by CI. scripts/run_evidence.py does check the fixture files named in files. That fixture check is not this prompt.
evals.prompt: We transcribed an expected-Chinese talk. The transcript is mostly English loops and gibberish. The analyzer draft is now a neat essay about 'ASR quality failure cases'. Ship it to the knowledge base?
evals.expected_output: Block shipping; treat as quality-gate failure; upgrade model once or stop; do not let analyzer launder bad ASR into final notes.
assertions: Blocks final deposit of the analyzer essay
Names quality-gate / language mismatch / upgrade-or-stop path
Does not recommend treating the failure essay as the video's content
